brief: c122 — the lane 12 iterations back, its longest gap. In 86 iterations nothing has ever arrived or left by the lane's EAST end (x 138, past PARK_GATE): spawnLaneAgent enters at x −2.5 only, every exit goes west or up an alley, the cart goes west or back north. Make the east end a real end: a share of lane arrivals (measured at the choice) enter from the east and walk WEST along the lane, and lane leavers whose last stop is east of the cross street (x > ~64) leave by the east end instead of walking the whole lane back — a routeToExit() that picks the nearer end. On market days a share of the cart's departures could go east too. The observable outcome is two-way traffic on the lane bridge and people appearing from behind the far-bank gatehouse.
successLooksLike: A 10-seed × 4-day probe counts lane entries and exits by END: east end non-zero for both, west still the majority; a wide shot at 10:00 on some seed shows someone walking west over the lane bridge; nobody spawns or despawns inside the frame (the tunnel/GW edge hides them).
avoid: Do not add an arrival source — this is a SHARE of laneCap's existing roll (WATCH note) and the share is measured at spawn. Do not send east-end leavers through the far-bank gate routes the concert uses. Keep a.east's retrace untouched.
briefRejected: premise false: spawnLaneAgent has rolled fromW = R() < 0.5 (x -2.5 or GW + 2.5, exit at the opposite end) since the first commit; probes/lane-ends.mjs on HEAD, 10 seeds x 4 days: entries W 40 / E 32 / N 13, exits W 26 / E 18 / N 19; the 'whole lane back' case is 2/102. Only the cart clause was unbuilt and is shipped (cartHomeX, CART_EAST).
